{{Top|leg}}
'''Almanians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almania]]. The Almanians were ruled by a group known as the [[Je'har]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Around the time of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Je'har became a merciless and brutal regime. The Almanians sent pleas to the New Republic, asking for help as thousands of their people were executed by the new regime. No help came as the New Republic was preoccupied with other crises at the time.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

[[Kueller|Dolph]], a student at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]], was an Almanian. He took on the name "[[Kueller (general)|Kueller]]," a famous [[General/Legends|general]] from Almania's history, when he led an uprising against the ruling Je'har.<ref name="EGTPM" />
